title: Starlink: Architectural, Astrodynamic, and Cryptographic Engineering of a Low Earth Orbit Mega-Constellation & The StarSec Framework
description: A comprehensive technical monograph, open-source security framework (StarSec CSF v1.0), and reproducible simulation suite examining SpaceX's Starlink constellation across orbital mechanics, phased-array antenna physics, optical inter-satellite networking, hardware fault injection resilience, post-quantum cryptography, and space cyber threat modeling.
